programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Cat's Paw
programme.desc: Hari Rhodes guest stars as George Corley, an underworld leader whose link with a police precinct chief is the object of Barney's brother's newspaper crusade in "Cat's Paw"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Hostage
programme.desc: Paris, still in his cover from a completed mission, is kidnapped and held hostage by a group of treacherous revolutionists in "The Hostage" on Paramount Television's award-winning series "Mission: Impossible."

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Takeover
programme.desc: A political boss hires a professional provocateur to stage a violent protest, in a maneuver to discredit his state's governor and elevate his puppet, the mayor, to the governorship in "Takeover"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Missile
programme.desc: The IMF devises an elaborate scheme to dupe foreign agent James Reed into stealing a bogus missile guidance system in "The Missile"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Blast
programme.desc: Henry Darrow guest stars as Gregory Tolan, the local leader of a revolutionist group specializing in robberies for the financing of a movement to overthrow the United States government in the "Blast"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: Andrew Duggan guest stars as Justin Bainbridge, a multimillionaire paranoid militarist, whose son, Howard, defected behind the Iron Curtain with the formula to a lethal nerve gas he had developed in "A Ghost Story"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Party
programme.desc: The whereabouts of a list of enemy agents operating in the United States are locked in the memory of a captured spy, Col. Vanin (guest star Frank Marth), and no one, including the spy, can penetrate his mind in "The Party"

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Blind
programme.desc: An F.B.I. man is blinded while investigating a crime syndicate attempting to take over a large chemical plant. Jim Phelps undergoes a delicate eye operation so as to appear convincingly blind when he poses as the sightless man.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Encore
programme.desc: William Shatner guest stars as an aging hoodlum who is artificially transplanted back to the 1930s and the scene of his unsolved crime.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Tram
programme.desc: The leaders of two underworld factions call a top-level meeting at a ski resort to set up a financial holding company capable of creating chaos within the national economy.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Mindbend
programme.desc: To help the IMF team break up a crime syndicate that specializes in brainwashing ex-convicts into committing political assassinations, Barney substitutes for a former prisoner looking for an operation to give himself a new appearance.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Shape-Up
programme.desc: Guest stars Gerald S. O'Loughlin and Christopher Stone portray crime syndicate bosses in charge of the waterfront who extort huge sums of money from every ship docking at a west coast port.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Miracle
programme.desc: An undercover agent is murdered while trying to intercept a huge heroin shipment in the Pacific Northwest and the IMF team is called to take over and put the dealer and his chief executioner out of business.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Encounter
programme.desc: Guest star Elizabeth Ashley plays the alcoholic wife of a crime syndicate leader whose involvement in an intimidation racket and the cold-blooded murder of an employee puts the IMF team on his trail.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Underwater
programme.desc: Stolen gems worth seventy-five million dollars scheduled to be fenced to an underworld figure suddenly disappear and the ship on which they were being transported is blown up at sea bringing the IMF team into the picture.

programme.title: Mon incroyable anniversaire: L'anniversaire de Chanae
programme.desc: Fille de pasteur, Chanae veut prouver à ses amis qu'elle peut être rock'n'roll. La soirée sera organisée au Rock-N-Roll Hall of Fame et la jeune fille distribuera ses invitations à moto en compagnie de son basketteur préféré de l'équipe de Cleveland.

programme.title: Rencard d'enfer: Michael, Brandon et Erica
programme.desc: Le rencard hippie de Michael lui fait reconsidérer le but des rencontres amoureuses, Brandon ne veut rien avoir affaire avec une redneck tandis que Erica tente de se soustraire de son rencard qui se plaint à longueur de temps.

programme.title: Rencard d'enfer: Audrea, David et Anjelica
programme.desc: Audrea passe un sale quart d'heure avec un pleurnicheur, la bombe avec qui David a rendez-vous s'avère être un homme alors qu'Anjelica a droit à un spectacle de marionnettes qui ne la ravit pas le moins du monde.

programme.title: Rencard d'enfer: Chelsey, Jessica et Jarod
programme.desc: Chelsey présente à Ansley un harceleur en ligne qui a un drôle de cadeau pour elle, le rencard de Jessica a des problèmes de carte de crédit alors que Jarod reçoit une proposition d'une escort-girl de luxe.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: La Nissan Maxima
programme.desc: Xzibit risque sa vie en apportant aux mécaniciens de GAS la Maxima 89 de Seth car la voiture n'a plus de portes avant.

programme.desc: Vanessa est l'heureuse propriétaire d'une petite Ford Festiva et elle lui a même donné un nom : Skippy. Xzibit et l'équipe de GAS redonnent à Skippy une nouvelle jeunesse avec un système nitro.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: La Honda CRX
programme.desc: Chamillionaire et Xzibit tunent la caisse d'un fan de BD qui adore entre autres "Les Quatre Fantastiques". L'équipe de GAS chrome entièrement sa voiture façon "Surfeur d 'argent"... Tout un programme !

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Le Van Ford Econoline
programme.desc: Xzibit et sa bande tunent la caisse de David, qui possède une société mobile de toilettage. Malheureusement, sa Ford Econoline de 72 n'est pas vraiment en forme.

programme.title: Yo Momma FR: West End vs. Northside
programme.desc: Après avoir réduit à néant la compétition , Mack et S.E.M.E. ne se feront aucun cadeau pour ces finales.

programme.title: Yo Momma FR: Douglasville vs. Clarkston
programme.desc: Chris Wreckless et JB feront montre de leur talent d'improvisation pour renverser leur concurrent.

programme.title: Yo Momma FR: Stone Mountain vs. Underground
programme.desc: Stone Mountain fait face à Amber dont il ne devra pas sous-estimé les talents. En effet, ce n'est pas qu'une belle femme. L'heure de la bataille a sonné.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: La Jeep Grand Wagoneer
programme.desc: Xzibit tune la Jeep Grand Wagoneer de Will, un entrepreneur toujours sur la route. L'équipe de GAS pose des airbags et toutes sortes de gadgets pas toujours très inutiles !

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: La Pontiac Sunbird
programme.desc: Xzibit et son équipe s'occupent d'une Pontiac Sunbird appartenant à Esmeralda. Les as du cric redonnent un second souffle au véhicule et installent des jumelles surpuissantes et une machine à glaces à l'italienne dans le coffre !

programme.title: Mon incroyable anniversaire: L'anniversaire de… Lacey
programme.desc: Lacey est la jeune fille la plus pourrie gâtée de l'Ohio ! Son quotidien ? Massages dans sa station thermale privée, cours de tennis sur ses terrains privés et virées en Ferrari. Sa fête d'anniversaire ? Elle l'imagine grandiose bien sûr !

programme.title: Mon incroyable anniversaire: L'anniversaire de Yashika
programme.desc: Pour son 16ème anniversaire, Yashika organise une énorme fête bling bling sur le thème "Diamonds Are Forever". Ses amis recevront des tenues de soirée pour l'occasion et Yashika recevra le cadeau de ses rêves, une Mercedes dernier cri…

programme.title: Mon incroyable anniversaire: L'anniversaire d'Etienne
programme.desc: Etienne est le fils de la célèbre actrice Sheryl Lee Ralph et il n'a qu'une envie pour fêter ses 16 ans, concquérir Hollywood.

programme.title: Rencard d'enfer: May, Prescott et Randi
programme.desc: Le rencard de May est dans tous ses états quand son autographe de baseball est abimé, Prescott essaye d'éviter une nymphomane et Randi prend part, malgré lui, à un publireportage.

programme.title: Rencard d'enfer: David, George et Nikki
programme.desc: Le rencard de David n'en a pas fini avec son ex, George est éberlué par la pimbèche avec qui il se trouve alors que Nikki passe son temps avec un prof de fitness qui lui donne envie de s'enfuir.

programme.title: Rencard d'enfer: Dana, Dakota et Victoria
programme.desc: Dana est brûlée par un débile à un rendez-vous cuisine, Dakota fait la connaissance d'une fille qui fait plus attention à son statut sur les réseaux sociaux tandis que le rencard de Victoria amène un autre membre de son boy band.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: La Crown Victoria Station Wagon

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: La Cadillac Hearse
programme.desc: Xzibit tune la caisse d'Andrew, un cuisinier qui possède une Cadillac Hearse de 70. Les garagistes de GAS installent des crânes dans la voiture, recouvrent les sièges de velours violet et l équipe d'un moniteur 42 pouces.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Le van de Wyatt
programme.desc: Wyatt roule dans une Daihatsu Hi-Jet de 1988... Plus petit qu'un mini-van, ce "micro-van" vit encore grâce à du rafistolage au scotch. Xzibit se rue sur la voiture pour lui faire le relooking du siècle.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: La Cadillac Sedan DeVille de Nile
programme.sub-title: La Cadillac Sedan DeVille de Nile
programme.desc: Nile décrit la situation en quelques mots : "Ma Cadillac est en train de partir en pièces détachées". Il faut dire qu'elle a acheté sa Cadillac 1978 pour seulement 700 dollars...

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: Gabi Prado vai para encontro onde lava roupa suja de um passado recente. Novas conexões começam a despontar, multiplicando as chances de novos casais.

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: Depois do abalo pela eliminação de um dos participantes, a casa volta ao normal. Gabi Prado ganha a suíte máster, causando apreensão em Raíssa. E um luau é o estopim para mais uma grande confusão entre os participantes.

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: Stephanie e Gabi Prado destilam veneno contra a última ex a chegar. Finalmente um casal quebra a maldição e transa na suíte máster. E uma Pool Party sacode o grupo, que aproveita o que pode.

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: No último episódio de De Férias Com o Ex Brasil: Um passeio de barco divide o grupo. Enquanto isso, o pessoal que ficou na casa descobre uma série de fatos que aconteceram ao longo do programa, desencadeando a lavação de roupa suja!

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: Os primeiros nove participantes conhecem a casa mais desejada dessas férias. São recepcionados por uma Pool Party. Igor chega de surpresa e arranca suspiros da mulherada. Vini faz comentários incovenientes e Mylena é quem mais se incomoda.

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: Andressa já chega intimando Gandy que fica abalado e explica a sua versão dos fatos para o restante da casa. Fernanda chama Paulo pra suíte master, mesmo querendo chamar Igor.A fila andou para Igor. Será que Yá vai levar numa boa?

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: A Chegada de Guto deixa Fernanda desconcertada. Durante a festa, Ya se irrita com Fernanda. Miguel fica muito bêbado, quer quebrar tudo e discute com Any e Mylena. E as confusões da festa repercutem no dia seguinte. Tablet anuncia chegada de ex.

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: Tati chega na praia acusando Miguel de ser um embuste, flerta com Igor em seu primeiro date e é bem recebida pelo restante da casa, com exceção de Any, que fica bastante desconfortável com a presença da ex de seu amado.

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: A chegada de Gui deixa Ya surpresa e confusa. Num primeiro momento ela libera o ex para as amigas. Mas depois que Mylena o convida para a Suite Master, os ânimos na casa se exaltam, elas discutem, se xingam e a casa se divide em grupos.

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: Repercutem as brigas que aconteceram na festa. Durante um passeio, Any dá um selinho em Vini e Igor irrita a todos por se recusar a participar da brincadeira. Miguel fica sabendo sobre o selinho quando eles voltam pra casa e fica bolado.

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: Dani (ex de Igor) chega e segue direto para um date com Miguel, que agarra a oportunidade de dar o troco em Any. Tati acha que Lipe está fazendo um jogo duplo e a empolgação de Vini com a nova integrante da casa logo se transforma em desespero.

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: A chegada de Arthur deixa Fernanda tensa. Mesmo com Igor ao lado, ela não conta que eles são um casal. Surge a bandeira vermelha da Cabana do Terror e todos especulam sobre o que acontecerá. Ya tem crise de ciúme de Lipe com Mylena.

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: O triângulo TATI x LIPE x YA chega ao limite. Além de darem beijos escondidos pela casa, Tati e Lipe ficam num luau, enquanto Ya aguarda o amado em casa. Lipe ganha o direito de levar alguém para a suíte máster e chama Tati, para desespero de Ya.

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: Mel passeia com Miguel, mas ele já avisa que está namorando. Enquanto isso, Any sofre imaginando o que pode estar acontecendo.Lipe se reaproxima de Ya que vai com o Fernando para um acampamento. Será que a Ya vai se vingar?

programme.title: De Férias Com o Ex Brasil
programme.desc: O ex de Dani e Tati chega à praia e já causa um alvoroço. O Tablet convoca Ya e Leo para um date e ela tem mais uma chance de dar o troco em Lipe e Tati. Para aumentar a tensão, Tati faz uma pegadinha com o Lipe quando chega à mansão.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: BACK TO OUR CAPTAIN! A JAIL BREAK AT THE SKY ISLAND AND THE INCIDENT ON THE WINTER ISLAND!
programme.desc: Desperate to reach Luffy, Nami risks her life to escape from an island of weather wizards. Meanwhile, Franky rides a carbonation high through the ice and snow in search of a seaworthy vessel!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: ENCOUNTER! THE GREAT SWORDSMAN MIHAWK! ZORO'S SELF-WILLED DEADLY STRUGGLE!
programme.desc: Zoro's escape attempt is thwarted by a gang of sword-slinging baboon bullies. Brook uses music to end a feud between irate islanders with unequal arms!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A DISASTER FOR SANJI! THE QUEEN'S RETURN TO THE KINGDOM!
programme.desc: Chopper hitches a ride on a giant bird, Luffy makes a shocking return to Marineford, and Sanji finds himself fighting the most beautiful man he's ever seen!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: I'm Luffy! The Man Who's Gonna Be King of the Pirates!
programme.desc: Countless souls have been lured along the Grand Line in pursuit of the legendary One Piece! Luffy D. Monkey is a young pirate with a dream: to prove the legend true and be king of them all!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Enter the Great Swordsman! Pirate Hunter Roronoa Zoro!
programme.desc: Luffy and his new companion Coby set sail in search of the infamous pirate hunter Zoro, rumored to be held captive at the Marine Base.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Morgan versus Luffy! Who's the Mysterious Pretty Girl?
programme.desc: Luffy is in the line of fire after saving Zoro, and now tyrannical Captain Morgan is out for their heads! Zoro must decide if he will join forces with Luffy or die in captivity.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy recalls a time when Captain Red-Haired Shanks taught him a valuable lesson in friendship and set him on his quest to be King of the Pirates.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: A Terrifying Mysterious Power! Captain Buggy, the Clown Pirate!
programme.desc: Luffy crosses paths with the clever thief Nami. A navigator on a quest to collect one hundred million berries, she’s perfect for Luffy’s new crew – except for the fact that Nami hates pirates.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji vs. Luffy!
programme.desc: Having delivered a deadly blow to Captain Buggy’s pirates, Luffy and his companions need a place to recuperate. But the three are not in hiding very long before the Beast Tamer Mohji seeks them out.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Epic Showdown! Swordsman Zoro vs. Acrobat Cabaji!
programme.desc: In the ongoing fight with Captain Buggy’s pirates, Zoro must face off with the Acrobat Cabaji while Luffy continues to do battle with the Pirate Clown himself.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Who is the Victor? Devil Fruit Power Showdown!
programme.desc: Luffy and the gang are on the run after the battle with Captain Buggy! With no place to go and nothing else to do, Nami finally agrees to join Luffy on his quest.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy, Zoro, and Nami arrive at an island hoping to obtain a ship and crew, but the three are quickly confronted with the blustering Captain Usopp – who has a connection to Luffy’s past.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Weirdest Guy Ever! Jango the Hypnotist!
programme.desc: Luffy follows Usopp to the mansion and encounters the brutal pirate Captain Kuro. The scoundrel plans to claim Kaya’s fortune and live the stolen life of luxury.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Expose the Plot! Pirate Butler, Captain Kuro!
programme.desc: Usopp spreads the word of Kuro’s evil plot and the impending pirate attack, but no one believes his warnings. The Straw Hat Pirates decide to help Usopp put a stop to the dastardly scheme.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Clash with the Black Cat Pirates! The Great Battle on the Slope!
programme.desc: Luffy and crew seek to best Captain Kuro, but they’ve prepared their defense on the wrong side of the island! All looks grim now that Usopp must face off against the Black Cat Pirates alone.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Terrifying Duo! Meowban Brothers vs. Zoro!
programme.desc: In an effort to save Usopp’s village, the Straw Hat Pirates seek to block the marauders’ path from the sea. With Luffy out of the battle, Zoro must face the fearsome Meowban Brothers!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Luffy Back in Action! Miss Kaya's Desperate Resistance!
programme.desc: Nami manages to rescue Zoro’s missing swords and attempts to revive Luffy. With one of the Meowban brothers down, the other rages on even more fiercely than before!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Beat Kuro! Usopp the Man's Tearful Resolve!
programme.desc: Usopp’s friends run away with the heiress Kaya. Jango races off after them, but not before sending Butchie into a berserk rage. As Zoro continues his battle, Luffy takes on Captain Kuro.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Protect Kaya! The Usopp Pirates' Great Efforts!
programme.desc: Luffy battles with Kuro on the beach, while the Veggies (with Kaya in tow) flee Jango the Hypnotist.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Anger Explosion! Kuro vs. Luffy! How it Ends!
programme.desc: Kaya rewards the Straw Hat Pirates’ efforts to save her with a ship to call their own – the Going Merry!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: You're the Weird Creature! Gaimon and His Strange Friends!
programme.desc: On the legendary Treasure Island, Luffy and crew encounter strange animals and an even stranger man named Gaimon.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Three-Sword Style's Past! Zoro and Kuina's Vow!
programme.desc: In the past, young Zoro sparred constantly with a girl named Kuina, but he could never claim victory. They vowed that one of them would someday be the world’s greatest swordsman – but tragedy intervened.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Famous Cook! Sanji of the Sea Restaurant!
programme.desc: The Straw Hats need a cook among their crew, so they head to a nearby restaurant and meet a passionate Sous Chef named Sanji.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Unwelcome Customer! Sanji's Food and Ghin's Debt!
programme.desc: Luffy witnesses the fighting prowess and compassionate nature of the Sous Chef Sanji. The good news: The Going Merry’s found a cook! The bad news: He has no intention of joining the crew!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Strongest Pirate Fleet! Commodore Don Krieg!
programme.desc: The staff and patrons of the Baratie panic when Don Krieg arrives! The starving pirate begs for nourishment, only to find himself denied. Unable to see a wretch starve, Sanji steps in once again.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Protect Baratie! The Great Pirate, Red Foot Zeff!
programme.desc: Don Krieg promises further malice as he returns to his ship, but the threat to the Baratie proves short-lived as an even bigger threat arrives!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Hawk-Eye Mihawk! The Great Swordsman Zoro Falls At Sea!
programme.desc: The Going Merry’s been stolen by Nami, and the showdown for possession of the Baratie is delayed. But the action’s not dead in the water – Zoro challenges Hawk-Eye Mihawk to a duel!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: The Deadly Foot Technique Bursts Forth! Sanji vs. The Invincible Pearl!
programme.desc: The battle begins for possession of the Baratie, with Zeff leading the cooks against Krieg’s pirates. Luffy and crew join the fray, but things aren’t looking too good!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Zeff and Sanji's Dream! The Illusory All Blue!
programme.desc: Sanji recalls his childhood as an apprentice chef aboard a ship attacked by Red Foot Zeff! When the young Sanji found himself overboard, it was the fearsome captain himself who jumped to the rescue.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.sub-title: Cool-headed, Cold-hearted Demon! Pirate Fleet Chief Commander Ghin!
programme.desc: As the battle for Baratie rages on, Luffy is forced to take a drastic course of action, and Ghin debates where his loyalties lie.

programme.title: On the Case: Gone in a Blink
programme.desc: A teenager waiting for her friends to give her a ride home from work suddenly disappears. When her friends arrive, they find terrifying evidence of her abduction.

programme.title: On the Case: In Broad Daylight
programme.desc: A young mother is murdered in broad daylight with her toddler just a few feet away. Police have little to go on except the bizarre description eyewitnesses have given them of the brazen killer.

programme.title: On the Case: When, Where, and Who?
programme.desc: A 15-year-old girl vanishes from her front porch, and police have only a few short hours to determine who saw her last, where she was going, and who would want her dead.

programme.title: On the Case: Field of Nightmares
programme.desc: A young mother and son are found shot to death in a quiet Texas field. Would a mysterious bag left at the crime scene hold the key to catching their killer?

programme.title: On the Case: Murder Ordained?
programme.desc: When a young minister's wife is found dead, it appears to be a tragic accident. But then, another member of the congregation is murdered. Police begin to wonder if its just a coincidence or a calculated plot.

programme.title: On the Case: A Ray of Darkness
programme.desc: Police must connect two vicious murders in order to bring a single killer to justice.

programme.title: On the Case: Pattern of Violence
programme.desc: A 22 year old real estate agent is discovered strangled to death inside a model home she was trying to sell.

programme.title: On the Case: Cry on My Shoulder
programme.desc: When a young woman disappears, police zero in on her violent ex-boyfriend. But the secret to solving the case is buried in a cold case file.

programme.title: On the Case: A Window to Murder
programme.desc: A valiant teenager's dying act helps police solve the mystery behind her murder

programme.title: On the Case: Hidden by Fire
programme.desc: When firefighters respond to a raging house fire they discover the blaze was just the cover up for a vicious murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Christina's Story
programme.desc: When a young girl vanishes while walking her dog on a military base, it marks the beginning of a missing persons case that would capture the hearts of the entire county.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder at Bird Key
programme.desc: A successful business man is found brutally murdered in his palatial Southern Florida home. A mysterious backpack found at the crime scene is the key to the case.

programme.title: On the Case: Courage and Conviction
programme.desc: A college student's battle for survival may be the key to solving a double homicide from years earlier.

programme.title: On the Case: Message In Blood
programme.desc: When police arrive at the scene of a grisly murder they wonder if the victim's dying act would point them to her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: A Predator in Deerfield
programme.desc: March 17, 1986 in Deerfield Beach, Florida 5- year-old Stacy Savage happily bounded up the street to the spot where her mother Angela Savage and her little brother met her after school. But when Stacy got there, her mother was nowhere to be found

programme.title: On the Case: A Harvest of Grief
programme.desc: Paula Zahn examines the tragic case of a trail of blood and broken cornstalks leads police to the body of a young girl.

programme.title: On the Case: The Killer Rang Twice
programme.desc: Linda Donahew, of Arlington Texas, was discovered stabbed to death by her sister one night in June. For nearly two decades the case remained unsolved, until detectives matched DNA from Linda's case with another case a few hundred miles away.

programme.title: Trauma
programme.desc: In this heart-pounding thriller by Italian horror legend Dario Argento, a young man tries to help an escaped psychiatric patient find the serial killer who murdered her parents.

programme.title: Machine Gun Kelly
programme.desc: The criminal exploits of Public Enemy number 1, George 'Machine-Gun' Kelly, during the 1930s.

programme.title: The Frog Prince
programme.desc: A young British girl journeys to Paris to go to college, and is determined to find the man of her dreams and fall madly in love. However, things don't work out quite the way she planned.

programme.title: DOA: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: The world's best fighters are invited to DOA, a martial-arts tournament. Four female rival fighters, an aristocratic warrior, a wrestling superstar, an athlete with a tragic past, and an assassin-for-hire, work together to uncover a secret.

programme.title: Fanboys
programme.desc: A group of Star Wars fans travel to Skywalker Ranch to steal a copy of 'The Phantom Menace,' so that their terminally ill friend can see it before its release in theaters several months down the line.

programme.title: Bill & Ted Face the Music
programme.desc: Yet to fulfill their rock and roll destiny, the stakes are higher than ever for the now middle-aged Bill and Ted who set out on a new adventure when a visitor from the future warns them that only their song can save life as we know it.

programme.title: Bio-Dome
programme.desc: In this outrageous Comedy, five brave scientists are forced to face life forms more perplexing, more terrifying, more annoying than anything they've ever encountered: Pauly Shore and Stephen Baldwin.

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: A firefighting cadet, two college professors, and a geeky-but-sexy government scientist work against an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving ever since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: A neophyte hacker becomes the target of the FBI after he unknowingly taps into a high-tech embezzling scheme which could cause a horrific environmental disaster in this suspenseful drama.

programme.title: Tank Girl
programme.desc: In this laugh-a-minute, futuristic thriller, a mega-villain controls the world's water supply, and it's up to Tank Girl and her outrageous cohorts to end his greedy reign.

programme.title: Clockwatchers
programme.desc: The relationship between four female temps all working for the same credit company is threatened with the arrival of a new hire, who lands a permanent position one of the women was vying for.

programme.title: Bejleren - en jydsk røverhistorie
programme.desc: Sejr og Maren elsker hinanden men kan ikke blive gift så længe herremanden nægter Sejr en fæstegård. Røvere hærger imidlertid egnen, og herremanden lover Sejr en gård, hvis han kan fange dem. Samtidig kommer en mystisk fremmed og anholder om Marens hånd.

programme.title: Ingen Tid Til Kærtegn
programme.desc: Den lille pige føler sig - med al rimelighed - forladt af sine travle forældre. Da hun en dag svigtes endnu en gang, beslutter hun sig for at tage sagen i egen hånd.. Hun stikker af hjemmefra.

programme.title: Violer er blå
programme.desc: Mille ønsker friheden og gør meget for at leve et sund og frit liv med sin mand. Dette lykkes kun til dels og familien får da også problemer, da Mille bliver indtaget i Kasper. Milles forhold til de forskellige veninder følges.

programme.title: Som sendt fra himlen
programme.desc: Laura skal giftes med Thorsten. I kirken svarer Laura nej, hvorefter hun stikker af. Hun ankommer til Alfred Kraghs hjem. Hun tror at Alfred er psykolog og senere smugler.

programme.title: Nøddebo Præstegård
programme.desc: Det er den klassiske danske julefortælling om de tre brødre Castrup, der skal holde jul på Reagensen i København. Nikolaj og Frederik får dog overtalt Christoffer til at tage til Nøddebo Præstegård i stedet.

programme.title: Elise
programme.desc: Melodrama, udspillet i en mindre dansk by, hvor vi følger tre respektable ægtepar over en tyveårig periode. Der hersker på overfladen et nært venskab mellem familierne, men forbindelserne er langt mere komplicerede end som så.

programme.title: Krudt og klunker
programme.desc: København 1890erne. Dette er historien om, hvorledes Therese Schrøder kom på pension hos professor Jacobsen og blev børnenes barnepige, hvad der havde til følge, at hun traf sin sømand. Dette skabte røre i de borgerlige cirkler dengang.

programme.title: Dronningens Vagtmester
programme.desc: Da svenskerne har besat en dansk herregård, beslutter Svend Poulsen sig for at hjælpe familien i sikkerhed. Undervejs bliver Ib taget til fange.

programme.title: Earth - Un Giorno Straordinario

programme.title: Kamchatka
programme.desc: Avventura sui vulcani per Aldo Mazzocchi: l’idea nasce dal desiderio di conoscere la Kamchatka, un territorio aspro, incontaminato e geologicamente molto attivo.

programme.title: L'ombelico magico
programme.desc: Un incontro magico tra un'anziana signora che possiede poteri ancestrali ed una giovane pronta ad ereditarli.

programme.title: La sfida di Venezia
programme.desc: Venezia è in pericolo. Le maree che affondano Venezia sono in drammatico aumento. Il mare, il grande alleato di Venezia da secoli, è diventato il suo nemico più pericoloso. Riuscirà Venezia a vincere la millenaria sfida con l’acqua grazie al MOSE?

programme.title: Linea 7000
programme.desc: Un viaggio sostenibile alla scoperta del più lungo sentiero al mondo, questa la storia di Linea 7000

programme.title: Long Way East
programme.desc: Il sogno di Federico Marretta, 26000 km dall’Italia alla Mongolia in sella alla propria moto, dove storie di uomini, culture e religioni differenti, si fondevano lungo la Via della Seta.

programme.title: I figli del Mozambico
programme.desc: Facciamo un viaggio nel Mozambico dei bambini di strada. È una esperienza difficile, dolorosa, come succede sempre quando guardiamo in faccia la povertà del mondo. Ma questa volta il racconto è addolcito se non da un lieto fine, da una speranza.

programme.title: Il riso delle Alpi
programme.desc: Divisi in piccoli gruppi isolati, i negritos Batak abitano una superficie di circa 240 kmq nel nord della verde isola di Palawan, l'isola dell'arcipelago filippino piu' vicina al Borneo.

programme.title: Mumbai
programme.desc: Mumbai, la capitale economica del continente indiano, la patria di Bollywood, una città che con i suoi oltre 16 milioni di abitanti vanta anche il più grande slum dell’Asia.

programme.title: Sari, sei metri di eleganza
programme.desc: Dalle piantagioni di gelso ai telai settecenteschi del Bengala, seguiamo la creazione artigianale del Sari Baluchari, il più prezioso degli abiti indiani. Un racconto di eleganza, tradizione e forza femminile nel cuore dell’India.

programme.title: Naturapolis Il Sogno Verde Di Parigi
programme.desc: Parigi, città di storia e patrimonio, affascina ma soffoca: solo il 5% di verde per abitante. La comunità scientifica sogna una Parigi più verde. Ma c’è spazio per la natura tra pietra e acciaio? Cittadini e esperti cercano nuove vie per la biodiversità.

programme.title: Naturapolis Da Megalopoli A Citta - Giardino
programme.desc: Tokyo, megalopoli in continua espansione, ha perso il verde ma non il legame spirituale con la natura. Cittadini e urbanisti riscoprono questo legame per reinventare la città. Distrutta e rinata dieci volte, Tokyo potrebbe ancora sorprendere.

programme.title: My Family and The Galapagos: Episode 2
programme.desc: Monty Halls and his family are in the Galapagos tagging Hammerhead sharks and discovering the challenges of island life.

programme.title: Nature's Force: Episode 6
programme.desc: Learn about the effects of La Niña and how Indian Summer got its name, observe the effects of winter on the planet, and witness the beauy of the halo and the devestation of Hurricane Katrina.

programme.title: The Biblical Plagues: Flight from Egypt
programme.desc: For a long time, scientists have tried to prove that nine of the Ten Plagues described in the Old Testament point to a serious breakdown of the climate.

programme.title: Art of the Heist: The Big Sting
programme.desc: On December 22nd, 2000 three of the world's greatest art treasures were stolen from the National Museum in Stockholm. Together the Rembrandt and two Renoir paintings were valued at 50 million dollars.

programme.title: Art of the Heist: The Lady in Gold
programme.desc: Chronicling the theft of Gustav Klimt's "Portrait of Adele Bloch-Bauer I" and the ensuing legal battles to return the work to its owner.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Creator
programme.desc: Creating is a deed that captivates minds. Today, we are better creators than ever before. We will see how we can play with conditions for creating life, make anything we can think of with the code of life itself, and replace parts of our body.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 207
programme.desc: A massive tornado rips apart a local high school while frightened students huddle inside. Then, intense wind and rain turn a high speed race into a demolition derby. Next, a raging river traps tourists and takes an entire town by storm.

programme.title: Wild Spain: The Atlantic North
programme.desc: From the Basque Country to Galicia: This is the North Spanish wilderness.

programme.title: The Spying Game: Tales of the Cold War
programme.desc: During the Cold War, Germany becomes the battleground for countless spies.

programme.title: Harry Styles: Are You Curious?
programme.desc: Harry Styles – Pop star, fashion innovator, and 21st Century cultural icon. See the remarkable story of Harry Styles' unexpected evolution from a teenage heartthrob to the most distinctive mainstream artist of the modern age.

programme.title: Art of the Heist: The Disappeared
programme.desc: Re-creating a crime in which artwork stolen from a Buenos Aires museum was traded for illegal arms.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 105
programme.desc: A violent tornado races across the Oklahoma Plains, destroying everything in its path. High in the mountains of Oregon, wild gusts send a helicopter out of control, and foil a heroic rescue effort.

programme.title: One Small Step: Neil Armstrong
programme.desc: Neil Armstrong has stamped his place in History by becoming the first person to walk on the moon.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the State Hermitage Museum
programme.desc: From ancient mummies who sport tattoos to re-examining who really killed Rasputin, discover the secrets inside the State Hermitage Museum.

programme.title: Muhammad Ali: The Greatest
programme.desc: The people who knew him best relive legendary fights and explore the life of boxing's greatest symbol, Ali.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 204
programme.desc: A powerful twister rips through a Minnesota farm house, and leaves nothing behind. Firefighters become victims when a violent rain storm pushes a creek past its limits. A flood in Nashville busts through a store sending everyone running.

programme.title: Full Force Nature: Episode 102
programme.desc: Hurricane Katrina hits Gulfport Florida with a fury, leaving some unfortunatevictims stranded in their hotel as storm surges invade the ground floor. In the Kansas plains a vicious tornado erupts out of nowhere and destroys everything in its wake.

programme.title: Wild Germany: Coasts
programme.desc: The episode Coasts shows the magnificence of the German North Sea and Baltic Coastlines and presents unique animal footage filmed over more than five years.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st airborne division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Varsity Blues
programme.desc: At first, backup quarterback Jonathan is no football star. But when the starting quarterback is injured, he is thrown into the game but also in direct conflict with his coach and girlfriend.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Fat Man and Little Boy
programme.desc: In the remote desert of New Mexico, “The Manhattan Project” is materializing – the World War II effort to build the atomic bomb.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: After Everything
programme.desc: Starring Jeremy Allen White and Maika Monroe. A young couple's relationship develops quickly when one of them is diagnosed with a life-changing illness.

programme.title: Empire Records
programme.desc: A group of young, anti-establishment Gen-X employees fight to save their record store from being overtaken by a conglomerate retail record corporation.

programme.title: Bright Lights, Big City
programme.desc: Michael J. Fox plays a would- be writer who works as a fact checker for a Gotham magazine. He spends his nights as an active barfly in New York City's club scene. But after he is fired from the magazine, can the young fan find redemption?

programme.title: Breathless
programme.desc: A fugitive (Richard Gere) heads to L.A. to track down Monica, a beautiful French woman studying at UCLA. Drawn in by the magnetism of Jesse's dark world, Monica can't help but fall for him and soon finds herself swept up in his run from the law.

programme.title: Bright Lights, Big City
programme.desc: Michael J. Fox plays a would- be writer who works as a fact checker for a Gotham magazine. He spends his nights as an active barfly in New York City's club scene. But after he is fired from the magazine, can the young fan find redemption?

programme.title: Breathless
programme.desc: A fugitive (Richard Gere) heads to L.A. to track down Monica, a beautiful French woman studying at UCLA. Drawn in by the magnetism of Jesse's dark world, Monica can't help but fall for him and soon finds herself swept up in his run from the law.

programme.title: Dangerous Game
programme.desc: Harvey Keitel and Madonna star in this captivating and controversial film about a director whose brutal honesty in portraying an abusive marriage begins to seep off of the set and into real life.

programme.title: Hwarang: La Juventud Del Guerrero Poeta
programme.desc: Aro descubre el plan del Maestro Youngshil para sacar provecho de la epidemia. El Maestro Wehwa les pide a Perro-Pájaro y Jinheung que trabajen juntos para encontrar una solución.

programme.title: Hwarang: La Juventud Del Guerrero Poeta
programme.desc: La reina Jiso comienza los preparativos para reinstalar el sistema Wonhwa. Una orden del abuelo de Dansae tiene resultados fatales.

programme.title: Hwarang: La Juventud Del Guerrero Poeta
programme.desc: Jinheung se declara a sí mismo el verdadero rey solo para ser desafiado por el Maestro Youngshil. Perro-Pájaro considera lo que ha aprendido sobre sí mismo y en lo que se convertirá.

programme.title: Hwarang: La Juventud Del Guerrero Poeta
programme.desc: El llamado de Jinheung a Hwarang en busca de apoyo antes de su coronación no sale como lo planeó. Perro-Pájaro le pide ayuda al Maestro Wehwa.

programme.title: Amor Bajo la Luz de la Luna
programme.desc: Hong Raon, la experta en corazón de la mujer, gana dinero dando un asesoramiento de amor. Raon fue a encontrarse a una mujer que amaba en lugar de su cliente, pero que apareció ahí es un hombre guapo...

programme.title: Amor Bajo la Luz de la Luna
programme.desc: Raon, que se vio obligado a entrat en el palacio para convertirse en un eunuco, tiene que salir del palacio de alguna manera antes de que se descubre que es una mujer, pero sigue pasando los exámenes.

programme.title: Amor Bajo la Luz de la Luna
programme.desc: El rey, que está cansado de la lucha contra los parientes lejanos, trata de hacer que Young gobierne el país en su lugar. Pero los malentendidos y los sedimentos entre padre e hijo agrava el conflicto...

programme.title: Amor Bajo la Luz de la Luna
programme.desc: Young se encarga el próxima cumpleaños del rey y el recepción del mensajero de Qing. y llama a muchachas del todo el país al palacio y compone la danza. Pero el mismo día del banquete, una mujer que tiene que baile sola danza se desaparece de repente...

programme.title: Amor Bajo la Luz de la Luna
programme.desc: El mensajero de Qing exigió un tributo excesivo, Young se opene al rey y Kim Heon que intentan aceptarlo. Mientras tanto, en la fiesta, Raon se toma vacaciones especiales y pasalo bien con Young.

programme.title: Amor Bajo la Luz de la Luna
programme.desc: Young, que se sintió cinfundido por Raon, trata a Raon con frialdad. Mientras tanto, Ma Jong-ja escucha que el mensajero está buscando la mujer que bailó en el banquete y llega a Raon a él...

programme.title: Amor Bajo la Luz de la Luna
programme.desc: Young y Raon están confundidos por sus sentimientos del otro. Un día, los rumores sobre el asunto entre un eunuco y una dama de palacio y Raon, que estaba ayudando en este asunto, se encuentra en crisis...

programme.title: Amor Bajo la Luz de la Luna
programme.desc: Después de recibir la confesión de Young, Raon sufre por no poder decir la verdad oculta. Mientras tanto, Ha-yeon, que tiene profundo afecto por Young, busca a Raon después de escuchar los rumores de 'el eunuco Hong, un consejero de amor'...

programme.title: Amor Bajo la Luz de la Luna
programme.desc: El conflicto entre Kim Heon y Young, quien porterga al examen estatal para prevenir la corrupción, se agrava. Mientras tanto, después de escuchar a Young que le ha dicho que la tratará como una mujer, Raon se preocupa y comienza a evitar a Young...

programme.title: Memorias Adolescentes
programme.desc: Los alumnos de la clase 3 realizan el examen que tanto estaban esperando. Whi Young no obtiene los resultados que esperaba en el examen. Joon Woo tiene una extensa charla con su padre.

programme.title: Memorias Adolescentes
programme.desc: Joon Woo le cuenta al profesor Oh de su visita a una academia de artes. Whi Young es interrogado por su presunta manipulación de calificaciones del año pasado, así que decide renunciar a ser presidente de la clase.

programme.title: Memorias Adolescentes
programme.desc: Soo Bin le confiesa a su madre que rompió su promesa y pasó la tarde con Joon Woo para celebrar su cumpleaños. La madre de Soo Bin le pide a la madre de Joon Woo que traslade a su hijo a una escuela cerca de ella.

programme.title: Memorias Adolescentes
programme.desc: El profesor Oh le advierte a Whi Ypung que dirá la verdad en la entrevista a pesar de las consecuencias. Soo Bin le pide a su madre que confié en ella y la deje hacerse cargo de su vida.

programme.title: Memorias Adolescentes
programme.desc: Joon Woo se preocupa por su madre y decide visitar su restaurante para averiguar que le oculta. El profesor Oh termina su primer semestre como profesor titular. Joon Woo toma una decisión sobre su futura escuela.

programme.title: Mi Adorado Encuentro
programme.desc: Joon Young ayuda a testificar en un caso de acoso en el metro dando una evidencia grabada, ahí conoce a Lee Young. Las amigas de Lee Young tienen una cita cuádruple y al faltar una de ellas, invitan a Lee en donde se encuentra a Jung por segunda vez.

programme.title: Mi Adorado Encuentro
programme.desc: Joon Young se da cuenta que intercambió mochila con Lee por lo que pide ayuda a sus amigos para conseguir su número y contactarla. Al encontrarse por tercera ocasión, ambos la pasan muy bien y se suscita su primer beso.

programme.title: Mi Adorado Encuentro
programme.desc: Lee acepta ser la novia de Joon y juntos asisten a un karaoke universitario en donde a pesar de la diversión, Lee Young-jae es humillada por So-hee. Joon busca a Lee pero es rechazado llevándolo a una gran depresión y a cambiar el destino de su carrera.

programme.title: Mi Adorado Encuentro
programme.desc: Después de 7 años, Joon y Lee se encuentran de nuevo en una redada en un bar, algo que mueve los sentimientos en él tras el evento que vivió con ella. Tomando con Lee, él le aclara que ella es el motivo por el que dejó su carrera y entró a la policía.

programme.title: Mi Adorado Encuentro
programme.desc: Joon averigua la razón por la que Lee se alejó de él en el pasado dejándolo terriblemente deprimido. Al saber la verdad, Joon se siente culpable y corre inmediatamente a verla lo que hace que de nuevo retomen su relación.

programme.title: Mi Adorado Encuentro
programme.desc: La familia de Joon descubre que finalmente está saliendo con una mujer, lo que les causa una gran satisfacción. Joon y Lee se ven en todo momento tratando de recuperar el tiempo perdido, pero a pesar de tanta felicidad, un evento molesta a Joon.

programme.title: Mi Adorado Encuentro
programme.desc: Joon se molesta al ver la distancia que ha tomado su relación y más por ver a Lee atendiendo tarde al cirujano Choy Ho-chul. Baek Joo-ran asiste a una cita a ciegas que al final resulta ser un gran fracaso. Lee pasa malos momentos atendiendo a Soo-he.

programme.title: Mi Adorado Encuentro
programme.desc: Se lleva a cabo el evento en donde Lee demostrará su talento como estilista, pero los malos tratos de Soo-he provocan una pelea entre ellas. Joon llega en el momento en el que Choy consuela a Lee, causando de nuevo un malentendido entre ellos.

programme.title: Mi Adorado Encuentro
programme.desc: Joon ayuda a Dong-jae a salir adelante en su nuevo trabajo. Joon prepara una cena para el cumpleaños de Lee, ella hace una reservación para un restaurante con Joon pero al no llegar él, asiste con Ho-chul provocando su furia y otro disgusto entre ellos.

programme.title: Mi Adorado Encuentro
programme.desc: Joon se disgusta de nuevo al ver a Lee Young cenando con el cirujano el día de su cumpleaños. Tratando de arreglar la situación, en una cena, Joon se desmaya por ingerir pimiento picante. Dong-jae ayuda a que su hermana y Joon se reconcilien.

programme.title: Mi Adorado Encuentro
programme.desc: Joon ayuda a Lee a llegar a tiempo a su sesión de fotos, pero más tarde al ver las fotografías publicadas, reclama a su novia por dejarse tomar esas fotos. A pesar de la presencia de la perrita princesa, Baek Joo-ran logra tener una exitosa cita.

programme.title: Mi Adorado Encuentro
programme.desc: Una fallida captura de un delincuente, hace que la agente Min y Joon resulten heridos, amigos y familia lo visitan en el hospital. Sang-hyun recibe una golpiza del hermano de su exnovia. Cuando Lee Young llega a ver a Joon, ve algo que le molesta.

programme.title: Mi Adorado Encuentro
programme.desc: Sang-hyun se enamora de la hermana de Joon. Joon y Lee se sienten de nuevo tristes al enfrentar problemas y celos de ambas partes. Joo-ran echa a perder su relación por maltratar a princesa. Lee y sus compañeros asisten a un viaje de voluntariado.

programme.desc: O documentário conta a história dos 100 anos do Fluminense, comemorados em 2002, revelando a trajetória do clube no futebol e em diversos outros esportes.

programme.title: Encarando Ali
programme.desc: Como é encarar o lutador mais famoso do mundo? Tricampeão mundial de peso- pesado, Muhammad Ali venceu quase todos os maiores lutadores da era de ouro do Boxe.

programme.title: O Homem dos Músculos de Aço

programme.title: Mexico Un Plato a la Vez con Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Cuando dices la palabra "enchiladas", es probable que estes pensando en los asuntos picantes y cursis que todos conocemos y amamos. En la Ciudad de Mexico encontrarás una variedad de enchiladas.

programme.title: Mexico Un Plato a la Vez con Rick Bayless
programme.desc: En Mexico, los tacos de carnitas han llegado a la cima. Trozos de cerdo dorados y crujientes envueltos en una tortilla de maíz, junto con un toque de lima y una cucharada de guacamole cremoso, representan la perfección pura del taco.

programme.title: Mexico Un Plato a la Vez con Rick Bayless
programme.desc: La tortilla de maíz es el lienzo sobre el que Mexico crea parte de su cocina más clásica. Rick nos muestra tres estilos de tortilla en la Ciudad de Mexico: tacos de bistec al carbón, tacos bistec a la plancha y tacos guisados ​​guisados.

programme.title: Mexico Un Plato a la Vez con Rick Bayless
programme.desc: ¿Sabías que la humilde albóndiga tiene un papel protagónico en la cocina mexicana? Explore las versiones tradicionales de las albondingas en el Bar Mancera, así como las versiones modernas en el paraíso inconformista Cicatriz, con Rick Bayless..

programme.title: Mexico Un Plato a la Vez con Rick Bayless
programme.sub-title: El Mole es la Salsa Madre de Mexico
programme.desc: San Pedro Atocpan es un pequeño pueblo que produce el 60% del mole que se come en Mexico. Prueba el mole en todas sus deliciosas formas, incluyendo el elegante mole madre, el mole rojo y un herbáceo mole verde con pescado que te dejará boquiabierto.

programme.title: Mexico Un Plato a la Vez con Rick Bayless
programme.sub-title: Un Recorrido por los Tacos al Pastor
programme.desc: Los tacos al pastor son los tacos más icónicos de la Ciudad de Mexico, todos carne de cerdo marinada con chile rojo que se asa lentamente en un asador vertical y se corta en rodajas con piña brillante en una tortilla de maíz caliente.

programme.title: Mexico Un Plato a la Vez con Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Los chilaquiles se sirven en todas partes, desde el majestuoso restaurante del centro El Cardenal hasta el refugio hipster Chilakillers. La versión casera de Rick será tu próxima receta favorita "en cualquier momento."

programme.title: Mexico Un Plato a la Vez con Rick Bayless
programme.sub-title: Chocolate y Churros, Desayuno de Campeones
programme.desc: En Mexico, los churros dorados y crujientes se sirven con una taza de nutritivo chocolate caliente. La receta de Rick comienza con el clásico chocolate caliente mexicano y termina con bocaditos de churro regados sobre helado de chocolate.

programme.title: Mexico Un Plato a la Vez con Rick Bayless
programme.desc: En Mexico, Rick te muestra este plato grande de sopa de tortilla reconfortante en un restaurante del centro y en una posada históricamente lujosa. En la cocina de su casa en Chicago, Rick usa la olla a presión de su cocina para hacer dos sopas nutritivas.

Ethan Whyte é forçado a ir para o futuro para tentar ajudar a humanidade.

programme.desc: Um antigo chefe da máfia japonesa suspeita de ser vítima de um ataque e deixa uma recompensa para a pessoa que encontrar o seu assassino.

programme.title: Nina
programme.desc: Um delegado de polícia é acusado de um crime e precisa provar sua inocência ao mesmo tempo em que cuida da saúde da sua filha que está à espera de um transplante.

programme.desc: Cassie, contabile e perfezionista, crede che la sua vita sia perfettamente sulla buona strada, almeno fino a quella di sua madrela wedding planner abbandona e torna nella sua città natale per organizzare l'evento.

programme.title: Amnesia d'amore
programme.desc: Insoddisfatta del suo matrimonio, Caroline ha deciso di divorziare ma la perdita della memoria in seguito a un incidente le farà ritrovare l'armonia con il marito.

programme.title: I consigli di zia Hope
programme.desc: Audrey si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere di una rubrica di consigli sull'amore speciale ma anonima. Mentre è lì, incontra il redattore capo, Morgan Cooper. Presto scoppieranno scintille tra di loro. Audrey sarà la protagonista della sua storia d'amore?

programme.title: Tutta colpa di Sara
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata notificata della richiesta di divorzio, una donna convince un ufficiale giudiziario ad aiutarla a riottenere ciò che le è dovuto.

programme.title: Almeno tu nell'universo
programme.desc: Marco, ribelle e irrequieto, trova equilibrio grazie alla solare Giulia, mentre l’amico Andrea cambia vita per amore di Dafne. Quando tutto sembra perfetto, un evento inatteso sconvolge le loro certezze, mettendo alla prova sentimenti e fragilità.

programme.title: Batticuore
programme.desc: La podcaster Samantha Desouza è incaricata di ospitare uno show per riunire gli amori perduti. Anche se l'amore è l'ultima cosa nella sua mente, Samantha si innamora dell'affascinante Jake. Questa volta Samantha seguirà il suo cuore?

programme.title: Lo straniero
programme.desc: L'ispettore Wilson è incaricato di rintracciare il criminale nazista Franz Kindler negli Stati Uniti. I suoi sospetti si concentrano sul professor Rankin, stimato e tranquillo insegnante, fidanzato con Mary, la figlia di un giudice della Corte Suprema.

programme.title: Mathilde
programme.desc: Nel crepuscolo della Russia imperiale dei Romanov, la prima ballerina Matilda Kshesinskaya diventa l'amante di tre Granduchi fino a quando incontra il futuro Nicola II.

programme.title: Operation Chromite
programme.desc: Durante la Guerra di Corea, per contrastare l'avanzata nordcoreana, MacArthur orchestra l'operazione segreta Chromite, infiltrando spie tra le linee nemiche.

programme.title: Le 13 rose
programme.desc: Madrid, 1939. Alla vigilia della fine della guerra civile spagnola, le passioni e le speranze di tredici giovani ragazze vengono spazzate via da un potere sanguinario e feroce, che le condanna con l'accusa di aver aiutato la ribellione.

programme.title: Il re vichingo
programme.desc: Europa del Nord, XIIIsec. Il crociato Max von Buxhoveden vuole distruggere le credenze pagane dei popoli del nord. La resa sembra cosa fatta quando in punto di morte il re cede il suo anello, simbolo del potere, al nipote Namejs cresciuto tra i cristiani.

programme.title: Ironclad
programme.desc: Nell’Inghilterra del 1215 infuria la violenta guerra tra i baroni e il re Giovanni. I baroni difendono con tutti i mezzi a disposizione i castelli che hanno occupato, contando anche sull'aiuto delle truppe francesi.

programme.title: Altamira
programme.desc: Nel 1879 Maria e suo padre archeologo scoprono in una caverna antichi dipinti preistorici. La madre, appoggiata dalla Chiesa, li vede come un attacco alla Bibbia. Maria resta divisa tra due mondi, senza modelli di riferimento, alla ricerca della verità

programme.title: L'Invincibile Cavaliere Mascherato
programme.desc: 1670. Ad Higuera domina l'Alcade Don Luis, illegittimo rappresentante del governo. Mentre dilaga la peste, un misterioso cavaliere mascherato che protegge gli umili sventa tutti i piani del perfido Don Luis. É Zorro, l'invincibile cavaliere!

programme.title: Sei Donne Per L'Assassino
programme.desc: Un killer mascherato uccide brutalmente le modelle di una casa di moda a Roma.

programme.title: Attacco Alla Verità - Shock And Awe
programme.desc: Dopo l’11 settembre 2001, il presidente Bush prepara l’invasione dell’Iraq per rimuovere Saddam Hussein. I giornalisti Landay e Stroebel scoprono che le motivazioni ufficiali della guerra si basano su menzogne e falsi segreti.

programme.title: Blue Steel: Bersaglio Mortale
programme.desc: Una recluta nelle forze di polizia si ritrova a giocare al gatto e al topo con uno psicopatico armato di pistola che diventa ossessionato da lei.

programme.title: On the Inside - La prigione dei folli
programme.desc: Un giovane onesto ma problematico viene mandato in un istituto psichiatrico per pazzi criminali e presto si ritrova in una lotta per la vita combattendo contro fantasmi nella sua testa e nemici molto reali intorno a lui.

programme.title: Blue Steel: Bersaglio Mortale
programme.desc: Una recluta nelle forze di polizia si ritrova a giocare al gatto e al topo con uno psicopatico armato di pistola che diventa ossessionato da lei.

programme.title: The Vault - La Rapina Maledetta
programme.desc: La banca in cui lavora Ed viene assalita di rapinatori. Allora li informa che il caveau principale si trova in realtà nei piani inferiori. I rapinatori sono intenzionati per ottenere il bottino, ma nell'oscurità di quel caveau si nasconde qualcosa.

programme.title: General Commander
programme.desc: Un agente segreto ha visto morire uno dei suoi uomini durante un'operazione. Deciso a vendicarsi contro Orsini, capo mafioso responsabile della morte del collega, non ha il sostegno della CIA ed è costretto a formare una squadra tutta sua.

programme.title: 3 donne al verde
programme.desc: Tre donne organizzano la rapina più improbabile del Paese: rubare milioni di dollari in banconote destinate ogni giorno al tritadocumenti della banca più sicura degli Stati Uniti d'America. Prendere il denaro sarà facile... ma riusciranno a scappare?

programme.title: Anglers Digest: Fiji
programme.desc: The South Pacific, a place so endearing in terms of the people, the fishing, and the diving, no place in the region can compare to Matava Resort on Kadavu Island.

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: Lindberghs Reindeer Lake Pike
programme.desc: Destination is Lindbergh' Reindeer Lake Lodge in northern Saskatchewan. If you have ever dreamed of catching Pike until your arms hurt, and some of them true monsters, this is your destination. Learn a few tricks and hang on!

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: Florida Bass and Flatfish Salmon
programme.desc: This episode starts in Kissimmee Florida, then out in Lake Ontario for early Salmon. Fishing during cold fronts can be challenging, but a few tricks will keep the rods bent and the fish hitting.

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: P.E.I. Bluefin Tuna
programme.desc: Destination is North Lake PEI fishing for Giant Bluefin Tuna on the Lil' Miss Maddy with Capt.Tony MacDonald. The team is up to the challenge... get ready for a true monster hunt!

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: Slow Death Walleye and Lunkerhunt Goby
programme.sub-title: Slow Death Walleye and Lunkerhunt Goby
programme.desc: An informative episode... first Walleye fishing in the north country. Attention to detail always pay off. Then drop shot rigs for Bass on Lake Erie.

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: New Brunswick Sturgeon
programme.desc: Fishing the St.John area in N.B. for Sturgeon. There are plenty of fish to enjoy but a few tricks, attention to detail and proper boat position can make it even more enjoyable.

programme.title: Fishful Thinking: Big Fish of the Year
programme.desc: A highlight of some of the largest fish caught this year. This is for the viewers who love to see the monsters!!

programme.desc: Exploring the rugged Paringa River mouth and jet boating the Hall in remote South Westland.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: A relaxing morning of whitebaiting with Sid—classic Kiwi tradition meets underwater spectacle.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: Fishing soft baits and exploring scenic fishing spots around the Cavalli Islands.

programme.title: Gone Fishin
programme.desc: A soft bait masterclass in the Bay of Islands, diving for scallops and a young fisher’s first spear catch.

programme.title: IFISH: Australian Salmon - Port Lincoln, SA
programme.desc: Local knowledge is always best, so when young Archie from Port Lincoln told me we were gonna smash some BIG Australian Salmon off the beach - I knew I was in for one hell of a day!

programme.title: IFISH: Spanish Mackerel - Namotu Island, Fiji
programme.desc: The apple doesn't fall far from the tree. Down rigging big live baits, deep dropping for monsters of the deep and popping for those massive surface strikes - what more could Jet and I ask for!

programme.title: IFISH: Black Bream - Bemm River, VIC
programme.desc: Traditionally bream fishing is a game of bait and wait... well not if Franks around! Local East Gippsland guru, Frank Milito, gives PW a lesson in using vibes for BIG Bemm River bream, that you really must see!

programme.title: IFISH: Sailfish - Darwin, NT
programme.desc: When Paul hears the word "Darwin", two things come to mind - Barra and Crocs! So when PW got invited to fish for sailfish, in 20m of water, he couldn't say no! Get out your note pad and pen, because you're about to learn how you can do it all yourself!

programme.title: IFISH: Barramundi, Horizontal Falls, WA
programme.desc: There is only one thing better than waking up in the remote pristine wilderness of the Kimberley - and that's fishing it! Join the Worsteling tribe as they navigate their way through dense mangrove systems in search of the mighty BARRAMUNDI!

programme.title: IFISH: Yellowtail Kingfish, Jervis Bay, NSW
programme.desc: "Catch the fresh bait, get the BIG fish!" Join the team for a step by step lesson in down rigging fresh baits for big angry Kings!

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 1
programme.desc: Robson Green, the actor and host of Extreme Fishing TV series is our guest. He has never fished for Icelandic salmon. We travel to the remote pools of Kjarrá by helicopter and fish pools that are untouched the whole summer.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 2
programme.desc: Charles and Alex Jardine travel to the highlands of Iceland looking for monster arctic char. Charles Jardine is a respected artist who specializes in painting fish and fisherman. The river they fish is a gin clear river, home to some huge trout.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 3
programme.desc: Tiggy Pettifer, a passionate angler, is visiting Iceland. She is a well known personality in the UK being a former employee of the royal family. Tiggy gos to lake Thingvallavatn and looks for the Ice age brown trout that the lake is famous for.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 4
programme.desc: The 93 year old Lilla Rowcliffe is coming to Iceland for the 30th time. Fishing the same river. Big Laxá. She brings along her grandson and great grandson that is 11 years old. Lilla has had an astonishing live and shares a bit of that live with us.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 5
programme.desc: Mother and daughter fish both river Vídidalsá and river Midfjardará. The mother Joanna Gibson is taken along with her daughter Marina Gibson who is a highly skilled fisherman and runs her own very successful fly fishing school in Europe.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 6
programme.desc: Robson Green is back with a friend and a colleague. Actor James Murray joins him for an adventure in Iceland. Fishing Laxá in Asum, or just Asum the two give a great performance in this famous river. Competition is on.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Lake Otamangakau
programme.desc: Andrew Harding and Matt Hince team up to visit a huge man-made lake - one of New Zealand's most famous trophy trout waters - in the country's North Island: Lake Otamangakau.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Southland Smelters
programme.desc: New Zealand's Southland's four major rivers are famous as brown trout fisheries, especially in the upper and middle sections, but in this episode Anto Hall and Mike Wilkinson are heading to the estuaries, to fish the annual smelt run.

programme.title: Cooking the Continent: Peru
programme.desc: In Peru, einem Land voller Geschichte und leckerem Essen, besuchen wir Arequipa und probieren das peruanische Chicha. Wir werden etwas über die Picanterías in Paucarpata lernen. Dann fahren wir nach Ica, dem Geburtsort des peruanischen Pisco.

programme.title: Cooking the Continent: Ecuador
programme.desc: In den Tiefen des ecuadorianischen Waldes besuchen wir den Nachtmarkt von Baños und fahren nach Puyo, wo Olly die exotischen Chontacuro-Würmer probieren wird. Wir werden von einem Schamanen am Amazonas über lokale Medizin.

programme.title: Cooking the Continent: Kolumbien
programme.desc: In Kolumbien, dem Land des Kaffees, werden wir etwas über seine Produktion lernen, wir werden Teil eines typischen kolumbianischen Familienessens sein, wir werden verschiedene Gerichte probieren.

programme.title: Cooking the Continent: Venezuela
programme.desc: Venezuela, ein Land der kulinarischen Vielfalt und Weisheit. In dieser Folge unterhalten wir uns mit Armando Scannone, Meister und Pionier der venezolanischen Gastronomie.

programme.title: Cooking the Continent: Guyana und Nordbrasilien
programme.desc: Guyana ist eines der weniger bekannten Länder in Südamerika. Wir werden sein lokales Essen probieren, eine köstliche Fusion der Küche von sechs verschiedenen Kulturen.

programme.title: Cooking the Continent: Südbrasilien
programme.desc: Unsere Reise durch Brasilien führt uns zu den Ursprüngen des Kakaos und endet in Rio de Janeiro, wo wir die Geheimnisse der brasilianischen Küche entdecken und Caipirinha trinken, das Getränk dieses Landes voller Emotionen.

programme.title: Cooking the Continent: Paraguay
programme.desc: Unser Team erreicht Paraguay, Heimat der Chipas. Wir werden Zeuge der Bemühungen sein, die traditionelle Küche, ihre lokalen Zutaten und die Guaraní-Kultur zu retten. Wir beenden unsere Reise durch Paraguay mit einem köstlichen traditionellen Braten.

programme.title: Cooking the Continent: Uruguay
programme.desc: Grillen, Kumpel, Dulce de Leche und wunderbare Menschen: Uruguay. Nach dem National Milk Festival in Cardal erreichen wir Montevideo, wo wir das typische uruguayische Barbecue probieren, die Candombe tanzen und die wunderschöne Küste entdecken werden.

programme.title: Cooking the Continent: Argentinien
programme.desc: In Buenos Aires werden der Tango, die Milonga und die kulinarische Tradition diesen Halt unvergesslich machen. Wir werden den Rio Paraná in Rosario überqueren und auf der Suche nach dem patagonischen Centolla das Ende der Welt erreichen.

programme.title: Cooking the Continent: Südchile
programme.desc: Unser Abenteuer endet im schönen Süden von Chile, wo wir lernen, wie man den alten Curanto en Hoyo zubereitet, Lamm essen und an einem Familienessen in der Südstaaten teilnehmen kann.

programme.title: Cooking the Continent: Unsere Geschichte
programme.desc: Eine Zusammenschnitt der besten Momente der Serie.

programme.title: Ceux de 14: Les Eparges
programme.desc: Les Éparges est un village de la Meuse surmonté d’une colline stratégique. Vu d’en bas, c’est un effrayant piton rocheux. Les Allemands sont en haut. Il va falloir monter pour les déloger.

programme.title: Ceux de 14: Les soldats bleus
programme.desc: À présent, la guerre s’est comme pétrifiée. Chacun des belligérants s’est retranché. C’est une autre bataille qui commence.

programme.title: Accusé: L'histoire de Simon
programme.desc: Sophie est ambitieuse et travailleuse. Ses efforts sont récompensés. Elle vient d’être promue directrice commerciale de son agence. Euphorique, elle a hâte de partager la nouvelle avec son époux, Fred

programme.title: Accusé: L'histoire de Claire
programme.desc: Martin est l’épicier de son quartier. Très apprécié par la clientèle, il a toujours le petit geste qui fait plaisir, surtout avec Julie, adolescente et cliente fidèle qu’il a vu grandir au fil des années.

programme.title: Un adultère
programme.desc: Julien et Marie sont mariés et parents d’un adolescent, Mathias. C’est un couple heureux et uni. Puis Julien rencontre la jeune Alice et entame avec elle une relation adultère dont les conséquences s’avèreront cruelles

programme.title: Robinson Crusoe
programme.desc: Robinson Crusoé s'échoue sur une île déserte après un naufrage. Par son ingéniosité, il transforme cet enfer en un foyer organisé. Il rencontre un indigène, qu'il nomme Vendredi, et lui transmet son savoir, tissant un lien humain profond.

programme.title: Robinson Crusoe
programme.desc: De retour dans la civilisation avec Vendredi, Robinson se heurte à la cruauté et aux préjugés de la société. Leur amitié singulière est menacée par le regard des autres, forçant le héros à défendre leur humanité contre le conformisme.

programme.title: Chez Maupassant: La Chambre 11
programme.desc: Madame Amandon, femme charmante et apparemment irréprochable, prend cependant des amants dans l’armée. Elle les reçoit sous le nom de mademoiselle Clarisse dans une chambre de l’auberge du Cheval d’or.

programme.title: Chez Maupassant: Au bord du lit
programme.desc: Les Tuvache et les Vallin, deux familles paysannes pauvres - huit enfants à elles deux -, vivent dans des maisons voisines. Une riche femme de la ville qui ne peut pas avoir d’enfant propose un jour aux Tuvache de leur acheter leur dernier fils

programme.title: Chez Maupassant: Ce cochon de Morin
programme.desc: Revenant de Paris en train, Morin, mercier à La Rochelle, se risque à embrasser brusquement une belle jeune fille, Henriette, dans le compartiment où ils voyagent seuls. Elle hurle de peur et Morin est arrêté.

programme.title: Chez Maupassant: Le rosier de Madame Husson
programme.desc: Madame Husson s’est mise en tête de faire couronner la “rosière” c’est-à-dire la jeune fille la plus vertueuse de Gisors. Après enquête, elle ne trouve guère que le fils de la fruitière, Isidore, jeune homme simple et candide.

programme.title: Contes et nouvelles du XIXème siècle: Le petit vieux des Batignolles
programme.desc: Paris, 1876. Godeuil, jeune étudiant en médecine, a comme voisin un homme sympathique mais énigmatique, Monsieur Mechinet. Un soir, Mechinet, blessé, frappe à la porte de Godeuil et lui demande des soins.

programme.title: Contes et nouvelles du XIXème siècle: Boubouroche
programme.desc: Paris, 1892. Tous les jours à 18 heures, Eugène Boubouroche joue à la manille au café. A la même heure, Adele, jeune veuve qui en a fait son «protecteur », fait signal à son amant Andre. Le voisin âgé veille et raconte à Boubouroche.

programme.title: Napoleon
programme.desc: À Sainte-Hélène, Napoléon se souvient de ses débuts : ses ambitions républicaines, sa rencontre avec Joséphine, ses premières victoires. À 27 ans, Bonaparte rêve déjà de transformer la France et de la sortir de l'anarchie.

programme.desc: Arturo tiene 19 años y es el dueño de un Opel Omega del 92. Estudia Publicidad y es mago, ilusionista y animador. Ha hecho muchos trabajos de voluntariado y actúa en una residencia de personas sin familia en muchas ocasiones.

programme.title: MTV Tuning España: Rubén - Peugeot 205
programme.desc: Rubén tiene 19 años y es el dueño de un Peugeot 205 del año 90. Trabaja en el campo con su padre.

programme.title: MTV Tuning España: Anais - Honda Crx
programme.desc: Anais González tiene 23 años y es la dueña de un Honda CRX Del Sol del año 93. Es dependienta en una zapatería. Le encanta ir de compras, escuchar y pinchar música y coleccionar vinilos.

programme.title: MTV Tuning España: Gemelas - Mercedes
programme.desc: Yasmina y Andrea son gemelas. Tienen 19 y son originarias de Mieres (Asturias), aunque pasan temporadas en Gijón.

programme.title: MotorStories: El Porsche de tus sueños en San Francisco
programme.sub-title: El Porsche de tus sueños en San Francisco
programme.desc: El fan de los Porsche Marco Wendlandt hace realidad su sueño: conducir un Porsche 911 coupé de 1984. Con la ayuda del gran Mike, un vendedor de automóviles de Los Ángeles, encuentra el coche de sus sueños en San Francisco.

programme.title: MotorStories: El forajido de Porsche, Magnus Walker - Los Ángeles
programme.sub-title: El forajido de Porsche, Magnus Walker - Los Ángeles
programme.desc: Marco realiza un increíble viaje por carreteras californianas. Con su recién adquirido Porsche 911 coupé del 84, se dirige a Los Ángeles para conocer a uno de los entusiastas de Porsche más conocidos del mundo: Magnus Walker.

programme.title: MotorStories: Historias de coches en el alto desierto de California
programme.sub-title: Historias de coches en el alto desierto de California
programme.desc: En su viaje a Las Vegas Marco visita al gran Mike en el Apple Valley, un área alejada en el alto desierto de California, donde conocen a unos curiosos amigos que en su día fueron los que marcaron tendencia en la personalización de coches...

programme.title: MotorStories: Mustang: cincuenta años
programme.desc: Mustang celebra su 50 aniversario en la pista de carreras de Las Vegas y Marco decide participar de este evento especial. Además, será testigo de cómo se fabrican Shelby Cobras en exclusiva para clientes de todo el mundo.

programme.title: Superautos: Estrellas de la carretera
programme.desc: La Silvretta Hochalpenstrasse de Austria es el patio de recreo ideal para el Lotus Elise y el Roding Roadster. Estos dos vehículos están pegados a la calle y, por ello, muy divertidos de conducir. Y además: el distinguido y potente Porsche 911 Targa 4S.

programme.title: Superautos: Caballeros corredores
programme.desc: Decir Aston Martin es pensar en James Bond, el estilo británico, el rendimiento y el lujo. El modelo Vantage N430 de la marca es un coche deportivo que hace que los conductores y los entusiastas sientan el legado de los coches de carreras británicos.

programme.title: Superautos: Conecta y conduce de lujo
programme.desc: En 2014, Mercedes-Benz presentó el S500, su primer híbrido conectable. Con un consumo medio estimado de 2,8 litros, el S500 era el coche de lujo más eficiente del mercado.

programme.title: Superautos: El RS no basta
programme.desc: Tras su lanzamiento, el Audi RS6 se convirtió en el referente de los coches familiares extremos. Su potencia y rendimiento ya eran impresionantes, pero según los tuneadores de Audi aun así era insuficiente.

programme.title: Superautos: Lamborghini
programme.desc: Sant'Agata Bolognese, la casa del famoso fabricante italiano de coches deportivos Lamborghini, es el lugar perfecto para observar más de cerca los diferentes modelos Gallardo de la marca.

programme.title: Superautos: Destacados
programme.desc: En este episodio, el piloto de carreras Patrick Simon describe algunos de sus momentos más destacados...

programme.title: Superautos: Porsche extremo
programme.desc: Porsche es una marca que creó su propio mito. El Techart Grand GT del tuneador de la marca es un Panamera extremadamente sofisticado. Pero el modelo GTS que está disponible en el mercado también tiene sus ventajas.

programme.title: 1886 - Leyendas de la Historia del Automóvil
programme.desc: En este episodio veremos: BMW.

programme.title: 1886 - Leyendas de la Historia del Automóvil
programme.desc: En este episodio veremos: VW.

programme.title: Autocine
programme.desc: En este episodio veremos: Lexus LFA y Lamborghini Aventador.

programme.title: Autocine
programme.desc: En este episodio veremos: Wiesmann y Jaguar.

programme.title: Historia del automóvil: Ford Mustang
programme.desc: Es el icono de todos los sedanes deportivos y descapotables. Ningún otro coche representa el estilo de vida de los 60 como el Ford Mustang.

programme.title: Historia del automóvil: Mini
programme.desc: Los Beatles, Peter Sellers, Britt Ekland o los Royals, todos ellos condujeron el Austin Mini. Diseñado sobre una servilleta, el Mini 1959 comienza una trayectoria increíble...

programme.title: Historia del automóvil: VW Escarabajo
programme.desc: Hay un coche que todo el mundo conoce. Un coche al que se le ha dado un apodo y no se le ha vuelto a llamar de otra manera: El Escarabajo VW. Con más de 60 años de antigüedad, nos dice más sobre nuestro siglo que muchos libros de historia.

programme.title: Historia del automóvil: Ferrari
programme.desc: Ferrari... sólo el nombre hace que tu corazón se acelere. Ya sea en la carretera o en la pista de carreras, dondequiera que el coche con el emblema del caballo saltarín ponga en marcha su rugiente motor, siempre será el centro de atención.

programme.title: Classic Races: El Campeonato de Turismos en Argentina
programme.sub-title: El Campeonato de Turismos en Argentina
programme.desc: Temperaturas tropicales, polvo interminable y curvas - algunas de las muchas dificultades para el hombre y la máquina durante el gran premio de 1964 en Argentina. Esta carrera fue la responsable de llevar a la marca Mercedes a la cima.

programme.title: Classic Races: Indy 500
programme.desc: Uno de los coches de carreras más espectaculares del mundo: el Indy 500. Vistos por un gran número de personas no deja de impresionar en el circuito de carreras de Indianápolis.
